about.title: A clean way to manage tasks.
about.description: This project brings together task organization, product browsing, and modern React patterns in one simple experience. It highlights reusable components, route-based navigation, API integration, and a polished dark mode interface.
about.feature1: Create, edit, delete, and complete tasks
about.feature2: Search tasks instantly with a focused UI
about.feature3: Open detailed task and product pages dynamically
about.feature4: Enjoy responsive layouts and persistent dark mode
about.feature5: Receive helpful toast feedback while interacting
about.footer: Built as a practical learning project for modern React development, clean component structure, routing, and REST API integration.
